screens.purpose: Start a meal entry (Step 1: Upload Photo)
Review and edit the AI draft (Step 2)
Meal name, meal time and save (Step 3)
Meal saved, Today's Calorie Budget and meals list
Weight trend vs calories in and out
Record activity and calories burned (not mocked up)

steps.user_action: Form is filled with Alex's values; taps the 'Continue to Dashboard' button
steps.system_response: Saves the profile (inputs for BMR) and opens the Dashboard

steps.user_action: Taps the dashed 'Select or Take a Photo' button under 'Step 1: Upload Photo'
steps.system_response: Shows the photo preview with Remove and an 'Extract Nutrition' button
AI analyses the photo and returns the draft with name, items, weights and nutrition

steps.user_action: Edits the weight (g) field on one item row
steps.system_response: Item kcal and the Calories, Protein, Carbs, Fat totals recalculate

steps.user_action: Chooses 'Lunch' in the 'For which meal of the day?' dropdown, then taps 'Save Meal'
steps.system_response: Saves the meal under that time and shows the success message

steps.user_action: Reads the 'Today's Calorie Budget' card, then taps 'Back'
steps.system_response: Budget (Consumed, Target, Remaining) and meals list include the new meal; Back returns to the Dashboard

steps.user_action: Taps the 'Take or Upload Photo' button
steps.system_response: Reads the scale display and shows the confirm card

steps.user_action: Checks the 'Weight (kg)' field (85.7) and taps 'Save Weight'
steps.system_response: Saves weight for today and shows the success message
Opens Reports on the Graph tab
Chart shows weight line against Calorie Intake and Calories Burnt bars; Target Weight 78 kg, Latest Weight 85.7 kg
Saves the entry and lists it under Recent Entries; if one exists for the date, asks to update or save as new

steps.user_action: Picks an activity, enters steps or duration and intensity, adjusts calories if needed, saves
steps.system_response: Estimates calories burned and saves the activity
